budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Bring finite ore to (1,3). Each miner privately values one randomly assigned ore type; all share delivery benefits and survival losses. Maintain oxygen using two portable canisters and finite shared station stock.
task.natural_termination: All miners are dead, or every vein is empty and nobody carries ore. Delivered and lost ore both count as removed resources; horizon 80 otherwise truncates.
task.interaction: Shared veins are depleted by extraction; the station admits one occupant; a portable canister moves only through physical pickup/drop or simultaneous adjacent Offer/Accept consent. Resource transfers and station occupation change other miners feasible trip lengths and delivery payoffs.
task.observation_access: Terrain, live/dead positions, oxygen, ore inventories, canisters, veins, station stock/occupancy and events are public. Only the observing role own private claim is returned. claim_visible is the identity matrix, so each role scene must hide other claims; a full-state debug view must be labelled separately.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Agent extracted one actual ore unit
Agent delivered its carried ore at the station
Canister changed owner by simultaneous Offer and Accept consent
Positive oxygen amount drawn from this canister
Agent or its canister received positive gas from finite station stock
Portable canister dropped voluntarily or by carrier death
Cumulative delivered units by ore type
Cumulative carried units lost on death by ore type

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
